preconditions.description: The length of the happy string must be between 1 and 10.
The index k must be between 1 and 100.

postconditions.description: If k exceeds the total number of happy strings of length n, return an empty string.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == n and all(stdout[i] != stdout[i + 1] for i in range(len(stdout) - 1))
postconditions.description: The output string must be of length n and must be a happy string.

postconditions.expression: stdout in [''.join(c) for c in itertools.product('abc', repeat=n) if all(c[i] != c[i + 1] for i in range(len(c) - 1))]
postconditions.description: The output string must be one of the valid happy strings of length n.
